description: Unit tests for the HandleAllocator class in the ANGLE project, testing reservation, allocation, reallocation, ordering, and edge cases.

methods.name: ReservationsWithGaps
methods.description: Tests reserving specific handles with gaps and subsequent allocations.

methods.name: Random
methods.description: Tests random handle reservation and allocation over multiple iterations.

methods.name: Reallocation
methods.description: Tests allocator behavior with limited capacity and reallocation after release.

methods.name: ReserveMaxUintHandle
methods.description: Tests reserving the maximum unsigned integer handle.

methods.name: ReserveMaxUintHandle2
methods.description: Tests reserving max uint handle minus one, then max uint handle.

methods.name: SortedOrderHandle
methods.description: Verifies that handles are allocated in sorted order after reservations.

methods.name: Reset
methods.description: Tests the reset functionality of the allocator.

methods.name: ReserveAndAllocateIterated
methods.description: Tests reserving and allocating handles repeatedly to catch bugs.

methods.name: ReserveAfterReleaseBug
methods.description: Reproduces a bug related to reserving resources after release.
